summary: Decent Holding Inc. furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated October 20, 2026, disclosing approximately US$3 million in cash collections tied to senior-care service-related commissions since September 2026, based on internal records and bank reconciliations. No securities transaction, stake, price, premium or board recommendation is involved; the release recaps FY2025 revenue of about US$12.9 million and gross profit of US$3.4 million, plus six-month training revenue of US$3.5 million at roughly 75.1% margin. It is an ordinary operational update, incorporated by reference into an existing F-3 shelf; no risk-arb angle applies.
